# Interview Assist

> Open source AI assistant for interviewers. A visible bot joins a Microsoft Teams, Zoom or Google Meet interview, transcribes it live, scores each candidate answer and suggests follow-up questions. Only the interviewer sees the coaching; the assistant never speaks in the meeting. Sponsored by Proso.ai. Apache License 2.0.

## What it does
- Live transcript of the interview.
- Scores every answer on correctness, depth, clarity and relevance, quoting weak phrases and describing a stronger answer.
- Suggests two or three follow-up questions, refreshed while the candidate is still talking.
- Sign in with a Microsoft work, school or personal account (any tenant).

## Important to know
- A bot named "Interview Assist" joins the call and must be admitted from the lobby.
- The meeting is recorded and transcribed. Interviewers must tell all participants and get their permission first; recording laws vary by place.
- Meeting audio and transcripts are processed by Recall.ai; AI analysis uses Anthropic Claude and Azure OpenAI models and results are stored in the operator's private cloud.
- Scores and suggestions are AI-generated and can be wrong. Humans make the hiring decision. Use at your own risk.
